metadata.datasource: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sampled characteristic curves preserve digitized Ilford Delta 3200 TI (2002), DD-X 9-minute vector trace density records with C1 interpolation. The first and last 12 points of each record provide monotonic extrapolation outside the published range. Runtime rendering data only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Edge inscriptions and approximate physical placement follow the manufacturer documents and developed-film photographs in edgePrinting.sources; see docs/print-frame-model.md. The DX edge barcode encodes the DX number cited in edgePrinting.dx.source. Development: ILFORD DELTA 3200 Professional fact sheet, September 2002 p6; ILFORD ILFOTEC DD-X, 1+4, 20 C, intermittent agitation in a spiral or deep tank. Reference time 9 min from the manufacturer datasheet; its curve was checked against that datasheet's graph (ILFORD Delta 3200 fact sheet, German edition, October 2002, p7, DD-X 1+4 7/9/12/16 min: all four curves overlay). SpektraFilm adaptation: the imported four-sublayer grain decomposition was removed and replaced by the composite silver record because the Spektra grain stage supports at most three sublayers; the sampled characteristic curves are retained.
